about.en: Alchip Technologies, Limited is a fabless ASIC design and production service company that takes high-performance and AI accelerator chips from front-end SoC design through back-end physical design, advanced packaging, testing and production, working on leading-edge process nodes for hyperscaler and HPC customers. Its shares trade on the Taiwan Stock Exchange as 3661, and tokenized and derivative markets quote the same equity under the ALCHIP ticker.
